source_recipe: One selected backend only. Fresh sigma0/ConstantZ H2, cp5000/psi0/sf0, MaterialReturn1, Model1/Ck2, dt2.5us/TimeOut.01s, event10s/TimeMax13. Source BAT caps at completed4000000 PRE with -nsteps:4000000, before next-loop release. Every Pre and Cor trial must be Elastic; failure is retained and no branch can bypass native loader qualification.
receiver_recipe: Three receiver Def templates use one statefile marker. A Windows PowerShell substitution writes a fresh per-output Def with this backend's actual absolute source PRE path, preserving root templates. Each receiver GenCase+one solver imports actual clock/history and continues to total13s; no PART loader, fake t0 or duplicate PRE frame. cp/sf/psi are 5000/0/0, 5000/.2/+2.5, 7500/.2/-5; cr1000/ncoh5/phi25 unchanged.
scheduling: prepare() replays scalar+=2.5us and the actual constant-.01 GetNextTime algorithm over4M steps before deriving filename from actual simulated PartFiles. Expected1001/Part1000 is asserted only after that replay. BAT independently checks actual Run.csv Steps4000000/PartFiles1001/PartsOut0 and actual last file exists. This does not certify native schema, elasticity, equilibrium or fields; the actual loader enforces those.
outputs: Source and each material output include CPU or GPU in directory name. Each entry refuses existing target output; the source remains available for three separate receiver launches. CPU and GPU source paths cannot be selected interchangeably by these BAT entries.
runtime: Only new closed r2 ReleaseCPU/Release programs. Four existing matching runtime files, retained C05 GenCase and accepted signed app-local CRT3, project LICENSE and parameter CSV. No Visual Studio/CUDA Toolkit/Python needed on server; Windows PowerShell, UCRT and suitable NVIDIA driver are required.
preservation: No execution now. Existing r1 ZIP/formal XML/BAT/runtime/raw data unchanged. Existing identical case LICENSE and parameter CSV are reused read-only; all new r2 destinations refuse overwrite. SHA only one pass over actual delivered key payload, manifest and ZIP during later authorized preparation, never old objects/raw data.
post_prepare_root_checks: Root full-read, real fresh-path extraction, GenCase for generated source and actual substituted receiver inputs, Release help/launcher path checks; no automatic local13s or10s solve. Actual source must still certify on server, and physical preload/collapse/figures remain separate reviews.
